zone.description: Telamon OS's default. Nothing on the network can reach this computer except replies to what it asked for, and: DHCPv6, finding printers and other devices (mDNS), browsing Windows file shares, Steam's Remote Play and game transfers to other PCs on the network (they only answer while Steam runs), and SSH once its server is turned on. Fedora Workstation's zone, without its open ports 1025-65535.
